reason: The README clearly describes an interactive web-embedded desktop pet focused on visual status feedback, layout behavior, animation, and configurable UI interaction, including controls for pending approvals and questions.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页中提供可拖动、可缩放并能根据任务状态互动反馈的桌宠界面。
summaries.en: Adds a configurable, draggable, resizable desktop pet to the DeepSeek Harness web interface that reacts to task and session states.

capabilities: Renders an interactive desktop-pet interface inside the DeepSeek Harness web page
Displays task, tool-call, session, context-usage, and activity status through animations and text
Provides user controls for minimizing, moving, resizing, and configuring the pet
Allows users to approve or reject tool requests and respond to question cards through the interface
